decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Photo Montage, Drawing Numbers A478M02A, M01A, received 19/08/11. Drawing Numbers A478 01 C,  02 C, 03 B received 19/10/11.)and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of ground floor rear and side extensions, with roof tile replacement and new conservation rooflights to the rear roofslope, replacement front boundary fencing and the erection of a new cycle store and bin store
